Hello! I'm a computational scientist at [The Jackson Laboratory](https://www.jax.org/people/selcan-aydin) in Bar Harbor, Maine. Originally from Istanbul, Turkey, I completed my Ph.D. in Biology at Duke University, studying the impacts of genetic variation on cellular phenotypes in budding yeast. My work now focuses on **systems genetics** — understanding how genetic variation shapes cell fate decisions and mouse development. Outside the lab I enjoy hiking the Maine coast, gardening, and spending time with my family and our dog Darwin. 🌿

[Learn more about me →](about.qmd)

## Recent Publications

```{r}
#| label: recent-pubs

library(httr2)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

orcid <- "0000-0002-0457-9641"

author_id <- request(paste0(
  "https://api.openalex.org/authors/orcid:", orcid,
  "?select=id"
)) |> req_perform() |> resp_body_json() |> _$id

works_raw <- request(paste0(
  "https://api.openalex.org/works",
  "?filter=authorships.author.id:", author_id,
  "&select=title,publication_year,primary_location,authorships,doi,open_access,type",
  "&sort=publication_year:desc",
  "&per_page=2"
)) |> req_perform() |> resp_body_json() |> _$results

render_recent_pub <- function(w) {
  title   <- w$title %||% "Untitled"
  year    <- w$publication_year %||% "n.d."
  doi     <- w$doi
  oa_url  <- w$open_access$oa_url
  landing <- w$primary_location$landing_page_url
  journal <- w$primary_location$source$display_name %||% ""
  url     <- oa_url %||% landing %||%
               if (!is.null(doi)) paste0("https://doi.org/", doi) else "#"
  authors <- map_chr(w$authorships, ~ .x$author$display_name) |>
    str_replace(fixed("Selcan Aydin"), "**Selcan Aydin**") |>
    paste(collapse = ", ")

  doi_badge <- if (!is.null(doi)) paste0(
    '<a href="https://doi.org/', doi,
    '" class="pub-badge pub-badge-doi" target="_blank">DOI</a>'
  ) else ""
  oa_badge <- if (!is.null(oa_url)) paste0(
    '<a href="', oa_url,
    '" class="pub-badge pub-badge-oa" target="_blank">Open Access</a>'
  ) else ""

  cat(paste0(
    "::: {.pub-card}\n",
    "::: {.pub-title}\n[", title, "](", url, ")\n:::\n",
    "::: {.pub-authors}\n", authors, "\n:::\n",
    "::: {.pub-meta}\n*", journal, "* · ", year, "\n:::\n",
    "::: {.pub-badges}\n", doi_badge, oa_badge, "\n:::\n",
    ":::\n\n"
  ))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: render-recent-pubs
#| results: asis

walk(works_raw, render_recent_pub)
```
